about_the_game:
In Project DINOZ, you play as a recon specialist sent to investigate a communications blackout at a remote research facility. What begins as a standard mission quickly spirals into a desperate fight for survival as you uncover the impossible: the island is overrun by intelligent, coordinated predators.

Cut off from the world, you must navigate a massive open island filled with abandoned labs, decaying outposts, and thick jungles hiding horrors below the surface. From misty mountain ridges to dark underground tunnels that echo with unseen movement—you’re never safe.

You’re alone. Outnumbered. Hunted. Every step, every sound, every decision matters. Stealth, timing, and resourcefulness are your only weapons.

The deeper you go, the more you’ll realize: this was no accident.

🦖 Key Features

  • Single-Player Story Mode
    Immerse yourself in a cinematic survival horror narrative where your only goal is to uncover the truth—and live to tell it.

  • Advanced Predator AI
    Face dinosaurs that hunt in packs, flank your position, and adapt to your behavior. Every encounter is unique, every mistake can be fatal.

  • Massive Island + Underground Network
    Explore over 30 km² of terrain—from derelict research zones and overgrown valleys to multi-level underground facilities where the real experiments took place.

  • Vehicles & Tools
    Operate dirt bikes, ATVs, and other field equipment—but be warned: noise attracts predators, and fuel is scarce.

  • Tactical Stealth & Resource Management
    You can’t outgun them. Use the environment—light, noise, and terrain—to survive unseen. Patience and silence are your strongest weapons.

  • Replayability & Secrets
    Discover hidden lore, side objectives, and branching outcomes that reward curiosity and risk. Every playthrough offers new discoveries and dangers.

  • Endless Survival Mode
    After completing the main story, test your limits in a brutal, single-player Endless Survival Mode. Scavenge, adapt, and endure against waves of evolving predators on a dynamically changing island. No missions. No checkpoints. Just you—and how long you can last.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 or AMD Ryzen 3 3300X
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 6GB or AMD Radeon RX 580 8GB
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 60 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: SSD strongly recommended. Lower settings may still require medium hardware.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-9700K or AMD Ryzen 5 5600X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2070 or AMD Radeon RX 6700 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 60 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: High settings target 60 FPS at 1080p/1440p.

short_description: The single-player survival horror game where you're hunted by intelligent dinosaurs across a vast island and underground facilities. Use stealth, strategy, and limited resources to outsmart the apex predators of a lost world.
